description: How to get from one of TravelCharika's departure cities to a place: the airlines that fly the route all year by Wikipedia's airport articles, nonstop or with the hub they change at and between which airports, each with its own booking page; the ways a record has (a year-round nonstop and its airlines, a road's distance and driving time); the distance and an estimated flight time; the airports that serve the place; and Wikivoyage's "Get in" for it where the site quotes one. Never a fare or a timetable: booking_links is where prices live.

from_city.description: One of TravelCharika's departure cities, by its airport code ("DEL", "LON") or its name ("Delhi", "London", "Bombay").

place.description: A place TravelCharika covers: its id from search_places ("bali") or its name ("Bali", "Da Nang", "Ubud").

name: how_to_get_there
title: How to get there
